rubric.firstPass: Blind free description of the place and visible objects; hide prompt, title and variant.
rubric.secondPass: Show prompt; judge each required object, exact count, material, relation and interaction separately. Place AND all main requirements must pass recognition.
rubric.visualQuality: 1 incoherent; 2 major visual defects; 3 readable but unfinished; 4 coherent and impressive; 5 exceptionally convincing.
rubric.pairing: Same saved blueprint, camera, resolution and 20-second camera path; deterministic randomized old/new order; archive ratings and dissent.
rubric.failures: Timeouts, rejected worlds, missing assets and absent images remain in the original denominator. Missing observations are pending, never zero milliseconds or PASS.
rubric.judges: Model review is diagnostic only and cannot replace independent human ratings.
rubric.holdout: Never use holdout answers as prompt examples or tune against the final acceptance run. Any changed case or threshold requires a new version and recorded reason.

measurement.sensitiveOutputs: Store model requests and responses only in the private run directory, never in the public dataset.
measurement.hardware: Record available hardware; software rendering is a separate weaker profile, not a reference laptop performance PASS.
